claims.text: ⍉definitive first-line tocolytic (ACOG); nifedipine and indomethacin most used
claims.quote: There is no definitive first-line tocolytic agent by the American College of Obstetrics and Gynecology (ACOG) but nifedipine and indomethacin are most commonly used.

claims.text: Indomethacin CI after 32 wks ← premature ductus closure
claims.quote: Indomethacin is also contraindicated after 32 weeks of gestational age because of premature closure of the ductus arteriosus.

claims.text: ≈48 hrs = USU enough to bridge thru steroids and transfer
claims.quote: Typically 48 hours of medication is sufficient to bridge the patient through the steroid window and transport her to a tertiary care center.
